City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 28, 2021 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of the Environmental Award Program Winners by the Environmental Commission Subcommittee
4B.
Encinitas Friends of the Arts Donation of Orpheus Sculpture to the City of Encinitas
4C.
Arbor Day Proclamation
4D.
Presentation by Dudek Arborist Kallstrand on the State of the Urban Forest
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
2021-04-28 Item 05 Oral Communications Received Before 3PM
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the March 17, 2021 Regular Meeting; March 24, 2021 Special Meeting-Closed Session; March 24, 2021 Regular Meeting; April 7, 2021 Special Meeting; and the April 14, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-04-28 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Fadhil
Approve the Warrants.
2021-04-28 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Notice of Completion for the Senior Center Courtyard Improvements and Equipment Project PR-RFB-20-04 (REBID). Contact Person: Recreation Center Manager Goodsell
1) Accept the Senior Center Courtyard improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-04-28 Item 08C NOC for the Senior Center Courtyard Improvements and Equipment Project
8D.
Extend use of temporary lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Express. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Authorize the City Manager to execute amendment number 6, extending the compliance agreement for one additional year between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Express for use of temporary lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-04-28 Item 08D Extend Use of Temporary Lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Express
8E.
Ratification of amendments to the Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency and the Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center for the Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Program for the COVID-19 response for emergency non-congregate sheltering to extend the program through June 30, 2021.
1) Ratify the amendment to the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego signed by the City Manager/Director of Emergency Services to provide hotel rooms for “high-risk” individuals that are experiencing homelessness during the COVID-19 pandemic to extend the term from March 31, 2021 to June 30, 2021; and 2) Ratify the amendment to the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Community Resource Center (CRC) signed by the City Manager/Director of Emergency Services to provide case management services for the current “high-risk” individuals utilizing temporary lodging at a cost not-to-exceed $350 per week ($50 per room per week) for seven rooms from March 31, 2021 through June 30, 2021. The costs for case management would not apply to those individuals participating in the Opening Doors or Homeless Prevention and Intervention Fund Programs, which is currently seven of the 13 remaining households.
2021-04-28 Item 08E Motel Voucher Extension
8F.
Amendment #1 to the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and AdminSure Inc. for Third-Party Administration of the City’s Self Insured Workers’ Compensation program. Contact Person: Department Manager II Schwarm
1) Approve Amendment #1 to the Professional Services Agreement for Worker’s Compensation Third-Party Administration (TPA) with AdminSure Inc., in the amount of $210,120 effective August 1, 2021 through July 31, 2026, and an overall contract amount of $389,950; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment.
2021-04-28 Item 08F AdminSure Contract Amendment
8G.
Amend contract with University of San Diego for services from the Energy Policy Initiatives Center related to implementation of the City’s Climate Action Plan. Contact Person: CAP Program Administrator Najera
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to amend the contract for services with the University of San Diego (USD) Energy Policy Initiatives Center (EPIC), in substantial form as attached to complete Climate Action Plan (CAP) related building ordinances and adding $20,000 to Task 7, with a not to exceed amount of $147,360 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-04-28 Item 08G USD EPIC Contract Amendment
8H.
Acceptance of the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project (CS19B), subsequently referred to as the “Project”. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the filing of the Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the subject project; 2) Authorize the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion; and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-25 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report), entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Accepting the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project (CS19B)” accepting the public improvements for the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project (CS19B) as complete to the satisfaction of the City.
2021-04-28 Item 08H Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements NOC
8I.
Renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-21 entitled, “Resolution of Intention to Order the Renewal of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District for FY 2021/22;” and 2) Set the public hearing for May 26, 2021.
2021-04-28 Item 08I Renewal of the ELLD
8J.
Safety and Mobility Enhancements Along North Coast Highway 101 from B Street to La Costa Avenue and Pavement and Striping Improvements on North El Camino Real from Encinitas Boulevard to Garden View Road. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-29 entitled “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Design and Plans for the North Coast Highway 101 (B Street to La Costa Avenue) and North El Camino Real (Encinitas Boulevard to Garden View Road), Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Authorize staff to advertise pavement and striping improvements on North Coast Highway 101 (B Street to La Costa Avenue) and North El Camino Real (Encinitas Boulevard to Garden View Road).
2021-04-28 Item 08J N101 Mobility Enhancements - Amended 04-23-2021
8K.
Public Hearing to consider and approve Resolution No. 2021-24 approving the FY 2021-22 Annual Action Plan for the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-24 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) approving the Fiscal Year (FY) 2021-22 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program Budget, and FY 2021-22 Action Plan; 2) Authorize the City Manager to transmit the FY 2021-22 Action Plan and execute required certifications to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD); and 3) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute all funding agreements and documents consistent with the FY 2021-22 Action Plan.
2021-04-28 Item 08K Approving the FY 2021-22 CDBG Program
8L.
Approval of plans and specifications, and authorization to advertise the Diana Street/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS17E) and North Court/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS20H) project. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
1) Approve the plans and specifications for the Diana Street/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS17E) and North Court/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS20H) project; 2) Authorize the advertisement for construction bids of the Diana Street/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS17E) and North Court/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS20H) project; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-26 entitled, "Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Design and Plans for the Diana Street/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS17E) and North Court/101 Pedestrian Crossing (CS20H) project, pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6" (Attachment 1 of the agenda report)
2021-04-28 Item 08L 101 Pedestrian Crossings - Amended 04-23-2021
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Encinitas Equity Committee Applicant Interviews and Appointment. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving on the Encinitas Equity Committee; and 2) Approve the Mayor’s recommendations for eight appointments to the Encinitas Equity Committee.
2021-04-28 Item 10A Encinitas Equity Committee Interviews & Appointment - Redacted

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
